cross_references.relationship: § 1801 opens with 'Subject to Section 1800.3' — the least restrictive alternative requirement is a prerequisite to any §1801 appointment; must be satisfied before any conservatorship grounds can be found

procedural prerequisite — §1826 court investigator report must be filed before the §1801 hearing; the investigator assesses whether §1801 grounds are met and whether conservatee wishes to oppose; no §1801 appointment is valid without §1826 compliance

§1826(a)(4)(B) requires the investigator to determine whether proposed conservatee suffers from §811 mental function deficits; §811 is the clinical framework for assessing capacity; links the legal ground (§1801) to the medical finding (§811)

civil rights companion — a court-appointed conservator acting under court order is a state actor for §1983 purposes; a county court investigator is unambiguously a state actor; procedural violations of §1801/§1826 by state actors causing constitutional injury (liberty deprivation without due process) = §1983 claim
